title: MCV2 immunization, SDG regions compared
headline: Worldwide in 2024: 76% of children receiving a second dose of measles vaccine
subtitle: Percentage of children who received the 2nd dose of measles-containing vaccine, as per administered in the national schedule
years: From 91% in Australia and NZ to 34% in Oceania (excl. Aus., NZ).
data_line: Data: WHO/UNICEF WUENIC via UN SDG Global Database, series SH_ACS_MCV2, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: Worldwide in 2024: 76% of children receiving a second dose of measles vaccine. From 91% in Australia and NZ to 34% in Oceania (excl. Aus., NZ). Australia and NZ 91%; Europe and N. America 90%; Central and S. Asia 89%; E. and S.-E. Asia 88%; N. Africa and W. Asia 78%; Latin America, Caribbean 69%; Sub-Saharan Africa 54%; Oceania (excl. Aus., NZ) 34%; World 76%, 2024.
question: What would it take to bring MCV2 coverage in Oceania (excl. Aus., NZ) up to the World level?
